label.zh: 研究“星门激活”并修复这座废弃星门后，第一座被激活/建造的星门
label.en: After researching Gateway Activation and restoring this derelict gateway — the first gateway reactivated or built

bridges.evidence: common/megastructures/05_gateways.txt:321-395 (gateway_ruined → gateway_restored upgrade, needs tech_gateway_activation, 6000 energy + 2500 alloys, 720 days); on_build_complete 419-480 fires apoc.10; apoc.10 trigger events/apocalypse_events.txt:183-195 (neither gateway_reactivated nor gateway_built flag)

label.zh: 之后修复的其他星门（已激活或建造过星门）
label.en: Any later restored gateway (one was already reactivated or built)

bridges.evidence: common/megastructures/05_gateways.txt:475; apoc.12 trigger events/apocalypse_events.txt:275-287 (flag gateway_reactivated or gateway_built; not the Galactic Doorstep or Sharpbeak homegate)

note.zh: 同一通知的两个版本：第一座被激活的星门显示 apoc.10，之后的显示 apoc.12。
note.en: Two versions of the same notice: the first gateway activated shows apoc.10, later ones apoc.12.

notes.zh: 评注：修复星门时，若有银河巨影DLC、修复者是玩家且尚无人找到过“夏普比克”，还有20%的抽签（权重×4/×2的修正）会额外弹出 paragon.3000，引出斯克兰德·夏普比克的故事（见 event-paragon-3901）。
notes.en: Commentary: when a gateway is restored, a player with the Paragons DLC may additionally roll 20% (x4 / x2 modifiers) for paragon.3000, which starts the story of Skrand Sharpbeak (see event-paragon-3901).

scope.zh: 从发现废弃星门到修复通知（首次/之后）的结构及触发条件已核对；斯克兰德抽签属另一故事。
scope.en: The structure from discovering the derelict gateway to the (first / later) restoration notices and their triggers was checked; the Skrand roll belongs to another story.

uncertain: The origin-specific notice origin.1050 fired next to apoc.10/12 (Galactic Doorstep) is outside this list and was not reviewed.
